name: Potenza (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Potenza (a yellow lion with a red bend beneath three stars on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Potenza, a comune in Basilicata; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Potenza arms — yellow lion with a red bend beneath three stars on blue, crowned, within branches
